items.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
items.improved_object: reusable collaboration contracts adapting the AAT workflow
items.reason_zh: contract 文档把角色输入输出、依赖与验证规则改成面向后续项目的可复用工作流；它由已验收项目蒸馏并初始化未来运行，满足程序外围策略文件的更新与保留。游戏 skeleton 和普通模块本身仍是任务产物，不能全部算 Harness。
items.abstract_quote: For each conducted and accepted project, we further introduce a training-free self-evolution mechanism to distill it into reusable skeletons, modules, and collaboration contracts for future development.
body_quotes: A contract is a document that adapts the general AAT workflow to a recurring feature or development pattern.

It specifies the role-specific inputs, outputs, dependencies, and verification criteria required to implement that feature, enabling agents to coordinate through a validated procedure rather than relying only on the generic build-and-review loop.
After acceptance, the training-free self-evolution mechanism distills the project into skeletons, modules, and collaboration contracts that initialize future runs (Section 3.3 ).

For w/ Experience, we let VibeGame with GPT-6.1-Sol build and self-evolve on 5 tasks randomly sampled from outside the ablation set, using the task rubrics and the vision-language model (VLM) judge scores in place of user feedback.
the main experiments use VibeGame without any accumulated experience, and we evaluate self-evolution separately in the ablation study.
We observe that when VibeGame continuously develops games of different types, the experience accumulated by self-evolution can instead lower agent performance.
items.limitations_zh: 主实验没有累计经验；自进化只在单独的小规模迁移消融中测量，组合了 skeleton/modules/contracts，不能隔离合同组件贡献。跨类型累计经验可能降分；没有原始运行复现或长期单调改进证明。
items.necessary_followup_zh: owner 应审阅后才决定收录；如需声称合同改写带来独立增益，需组件隔离与版本差异证据。
